items.html:
Verified current documentation features:

  • Machine-readable entry point: llms.txt is a curated index of tutorials, APIs, compatibility, and contributor guidance. The homepage advertises it visibly and through <link rel="alternate" type="text/plain">.
  • Version-matched Markdown with expanded API signatures/docstrings: index links currently target release 0.2.0. For example, transforms Markdown contains rendered overloads, contracts, examples, and links—not unresolved mkdocstrings directives.
  • Machine documentation is tested: mkdocs_hooks.py checks discovery markup, existence and version scope of indexed pages, expanded public API content, and malformed Markdown.
  • Executable examples: tutorials have browser Run buttons using the actual Advect Pyodide wheel; prerequisite snippets run automatically in the page’s shared session. The same snippets are executed natively and in Pyodide CI. Documentation guide.
  • Interactive playground: real NumPy expressions and derivative/computation graphs, with JVP/VJP and traced/optimized views. Playground.
  • Explicit contributor routing: short root and scoped AGENTS.md files specify Owns / Must not own / Read / Verify, linking canonical codebase, architecture, and testing guides rather than duplicating context. Root AGENTS.md.

Avoid claiming llms-full.txt or a “Copy for LLM” feature: the former returns 404; the theme has ordinary code-copy buttons only.
